items.headline: Cybersecurity stocks rally as investors focus on AI-enabled threats
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks shares rose sharply as investors viewed cybersecurity companies as potential beneficiaries of rising concern about AI-related threats and security risks.

items.headline: Oracle shares pressured by capital-spending concerns
items.summary: Oracle shares fell as investors focused on capital-spending concerns and Larry Ellison’s canceled planned stock-sale program.

items.headline: ServiceNow rises as investors reassess AI competition risks for software
items.summary: ServiceNow shares advanced as investors reassessed whether established enterprise-software companies face as much competitive pressure from AI as previously feared.

items.headline: AI-safety slowdown concerns weigh on chip stocks
items.summary: Investors remained concerned that calls to slow frontier-AI development could reduce or delay portions of the expected AI infrastructure buildout; the report said chip and memory companies had already been hit.

items.headline: Broadcom and other AI-linked shares face pressure after safety warnings
items.summary: AI-related sectors, including chip and memory companies, came under pressure after prominent AI figures raised concerns about the pace and risks of development.

items.headline: Infosys rallies as investors rotate toward AI services and implementation
items.summary: Infosys shares rose about 6% as the market interpreted calls for more cautious frontier-AI development as potentially supportive of established IT-services and implementation providers.

items.headline: U.S. stocks slip as oil and bond yields add pressure
items.summary: The broader U.S. market moved lower as higher oil prices and bond-market pressure compounded investor concerns around technology and AI-linked shares.
